title: TestCraft Setup Guide
summary: Teams configure one file — no code changes. Copy application-local.properties.example and fill in your Jira, Zephyr, and AI credentials.

steps.title: Set Jira credentials
steps.details: jira.base-url, jira.username, jira.api-token from Atlassian API tokens page

steps.title: Set Zephyr Scale token
steps.details: zephyr.scale-cloud-api-token from Jira → Apps → Zephyr Scale → API Access Tokens. EU sites: zephyr.scale-cloud-base-url=https://eu.api.zephyrscale.smartbear.com/v2

steps.title: Set default project
steps.details: zephyr.default-project-key and zephyr.default-project-id for your Jira project

steps.title: Configure AI (optional)
steps.details: ai.provider=gemini and ai.gemini.model=gemini-3.5-flash-lite (or another generateContent model from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models). Alternatives: mock, groq, openai, azure-gateway

steps.title: Start frontend
steps.command: cd testcraft/frontend && npm install && npm run dev

steps.title: Verify connections
steps.details: Open Settings → Test connections. Jira should show connected; Zephyr Scale JWT should show configured.
